name: Baked Salmon with Dill Yogurt Sauce and Rice

components.name: Baked Salmon
steps: Preheat oven to 200 C. Lightly oil a baking sheet and place patted-dry salmon fillets skin side down.
Brush salmon with oil and salt and bake 12-18 minutes until it reaches 63 C.
Divide salmon and rice between five meal containers, pack yogurt sauce in separate leakproof cups and add it cold after reheating.

components.name: Basmati Rice
steps: In parallel cook dry rice with measured water and allow it to rest covered before fluffing.

components.name: Dill Yogurt Sauce
steps: Mix Greek yogurt with dill, mustard, lemon juice, shallot and salt. Reserve in a clean separate container; do not dip tools that touch raw salmon back into this sauce.
